now.title: Avengers: Endgame
now.text: At Camp Lehigh in 1970, Howard talks about fatherhood with a disguised Steve as his first child is on the way.

proposed.text: At Camp Lehigh in 1970, Howard talks about fatherhood with a disguised Tony as his first child is on the way.

changes.evidence: In Avengers: Endgame, at Camp Lehigh in 1970 it is Tony (posing as a visitor) who meets and talks with his father Howard about fatherhood; Steve only sees Peggy through a window there.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 30, in 1945, Peggy Carter's SSR raids HYDRA's last base in Austria and arrests its commander, Werner Reinhardt.

proposed.text: In episode 23, in 1945, Peggy Carter's SSR raids HYDRA's last base in Austria and arrests its commander, Werner Reinhardt.

changes.evidence: The 1945 SSR raid on HYDRA's last base in Austria and Reinhardt's capture are shown in season 2 premiere 'Shadows' (episode 23 overall). Episode 30, 'The Things We Bury', only recounts that Reinhardt had been imprisoned by Carter and shows his 1989 release. The Howling Commandos, Dugan, Morita and SSR files already tag this raid as episode 23.
